runtime.note: Claude Code agent dispatch TTL at the time this rule was authored.

ceiling.calibration_basis: Empirical observation across viblocks-waas codegen workflows: dispatches with N ≥ 18 items truncated in ~20% of runs; N ≤ 14 truncated < 2%. To be re-calibrated quarterly from orchestrator telemetry.

backend-crypto-implementer.rationale: Cryptographic flows share invariants; partial completion can leak state.

backend-crypto-reviewer.rationale: Reviewers are read-only; per-item atomicity trivially satisfied. Default abort for safety.

note: With these values: cap = floor(18 * 0.8) = 14 items per dispatch. Workflows that need more must split into sub-batches; see viv-aidlc-orchestrator#12 for the splitter.
